title: Water Damage Mitigation Final Invoice, Due Date and Job Closing
content:
## Accounts receivable policy — Water Damage Mitigation

The job must be in drying complete status when the final invoice is issued. The final invoice amount is the total of every charge line on the job at the moment of invoicing, and the payment due date is the invoice date plus the self-pay payment terms on a self-pay job or plus the insurance payment terms on an insurance claim job, counted in calendar days. The job closes when its balance due is exactly zero after the final invoice; a job with a credit balance stays invoiced until the credit is refunded.

## Due date by funding source
| Funding source of the job | Terms counted from the invoice date |
|---|---|
| Self-pay | the tier's self-pay payment terms, in calendar days |
| Insurance claim | the tier's insurance payment terms, in calendar days |

## Worked dates (hypothetical terms of 15 and 45 calendar days)
An invoice issued on April 5 falls due on April 20 under 15-day terms and on May 20 under 45-day terms, every calendar day counting.

## Closing
| Balance due after the final invoice | Job status |
|---|---|
| exactly zero | the job closes |
| above zero | the job stays invoiced |
| below zero (a credit balance) | the job stays invoiced until the credit is refunded |
